answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 7079 Country: AF Title: I want to know the rulling regarding the beverags like Pepsi, Merinda, 3 horses malt beverage & other so called non alcoholic beverages, whether they are allowed to be drank or not. Question: asalamu alikum dear scholar, I want to know the rulling regarding the beverags like Pepsi, Merinda, 3 horses malt beverage & other so called non alcoholic beverages, whether they are allowed to be drank or not. wasalam wb. Answer ID: 7079 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1538/1321=B/1429) If these drinks are free from impure and haram ingredients and you are sure of it, then there is no wrong in taking the same. If there is a doubt, then one should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
